items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Fernando L. Gonzalez as the compiler of a book; INTERVIEWEE does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: And it's listed in a book called Discofile, the discographical catalog of American rock and roll and rhythm and blues, vocal harmony groups, the second edition nineteen two to 1976. Compiled by Fernando L. Gonzalez. I recall when one of the first editions of this book was coming out several years ago. 1964 and a few (inaudible) away, there's the Sunsets which was recorded on Rae-Cox. "How I Remember" and "Sitting and Crying."
This was in 1959 apparently that they recorded. Probably one of the very first --
